segments.title: Your AI plan can shrink overnight
segments.say: Your paid AI plan's limits can shrink overnight. Here's how to stay ready.

segments.title: Grok users hit it this month
segments.say: This month, some Grok users ran out of their weekly limit in days.

segments.title: The reason: it costs a lot
segments.say: Elon Musk said serving it cost too much for what it brought in. So limits can change fast.

segments.title: 3 habits that help
segments.say: Check your usage weekly, keep a free backup, and don't prepay a year.
